::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
India's first semiconductor facility in the Northeast. Demonstrates that chip manufacturing isn't limited to Gujarat.
:::

## What does this facility make?

Assembles and tests semiconductor chips at high volume — 48 million chips per day at full capacity. Handles multiple packaging formats for diverse end markets.

## Why does it matter?

Locating a major semiconductor facility in Assam is a deliberate industrial policy choice. It brings high-tech jobs and supply chain development to the Northeast, a region that has historically been bypassed by India's manufacturing boom. The Rs.27,000 crore investment is also the largest single private-sector industrial investment in the Northeast.

## Project Timeline

- **29 Feb 2024** — Union Cabinet approves TSAT under ISM
- **01 Jul 2024** — Construction begins at Jagiroad, Morigaon
- **30 Apr 2026** — Phase 1 commissioning expected (original target)
- **31 May 2026** — Union Minister Vaishnaw states ₹27,000 Cr Jagiroad semiconductor plant likely to begin operations within current fiscal year (FY2026-27)
